$comment: See adr/0001-artex-pinning.md. artex_git_sha is the authoritative pin; image_digest records what was actually built from it.
artex_git_describe_note: No tags exist in the local checkout, so git describe cannot run. artex_version is taken from the GitHub release, which is the newest tag upstream.
image_digest_note: Filled by `artexctl up` on first successful build; null means 'record me'. Swap image_ref to ghcr.io/baarai/artex@sha256:... once the package is publicly pullable.
